candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/spend.py:55-60 (float(raw) parses nan and inf, and only value < 0 is refused); spend.py:162 `spent + reserved + projected_usd > cap` is False against nan

candidates.title: CI never holds core/uv.lock: a stale lock is rewritten in CI and passes
candidates.statement: The workflow runs no frozen or locked sync, and every verify stage reaches Python through `uv run --all-extras`, which re-locks a lock that no longer matches pyproject.toml and goes on; `uv lock --check` refuses the same lock.
candidates.contract: CLAUDE.md:20 'Install: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then cd core && uv sync --frozen --all-extras'; CLAUDE.md:40 'BioSTEAM 2.54.0, thermosteam 0.54.2 and biorefineries 2.35.1 are pinned in core/uv.lock'; verify.yml:16-19 'test:core asks for the extra so the locked one is used'
candidates.expected: CI fails on a commit whose core/uv.lock does not match core/pyproject.toml (a `uv lock --check` or `uv sync --frozen`/`--locked` step), as the JS side holds pnpm-lock with --frozen-lockfile
candidates.observed: uv lock --check: exit 1; uv run --all-extras: exit 0, 'uv run ran', and core/uv.lock rewritten (1 file changed, 1 insertion, 1 deletion)
candidates.cause: .github/workflows/verify.yml:57-85 (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then pnpm verify and pnpm prove; no uv sync step) and package.json scripts test:core, test:sim, test:lit, check:licences, check:tools, gen:api, gen:components (`uv run --all-extras`, neither --frozen nor --locked)
candidates.evidence: lock_drift.sh in H12's second worktree, offline (uv's cache alone): one constraint loosened in the sim extra (pyyaml>=6 to >=6.0.1). thermosteam is pinned by the lock alone (pyproject pins biosteam and biorefineries; biosteam 2.54.0 requires thermosteam>=0.54.1). prove runs `uv run --frozen`, which reads whatever lock verify's stages left in the checkout.
